requirements.note: Newest-first feed; author, handle, relative time, full text, rounded full-width images at native aspect, carousels with titled cards that snap card by card and a '9 in this collection' header.
Heart toggles fill/colour and count (872→873); reply count shown.

Tapping a post pushes a detail screen with a larger image and absolute timestamp; tapping an image (feed, detail or carousel card) opens a black full-screen viewer that a swipe down dismisses; a short drag springs back.
Pull to refresh adds 3 posts at the top, count goes 400→403, and a '3 fresh posts added' toast appears.
Compose sheet with placeholder; Post is disabled when the text is empty or only spaces; the new post appears at the top.
Like, composed post and refreshed posts all survive relaunch.

bugs: Refreshed posts are ordered 401,402,403 top-down, so the 'newest' one is not first (all are labelled 'now', so it is hardly visible).
tells: Custom branded header (red logo tile plus serif 'Feed') and a 'Life, in good company.' hero instead of a standard large title that collapses into the nav bar; the header stays the same size when scrolling.
Posts are drawn as rounded white cards on a beige background, a web/marketing look rather than an iOS list.
At the largest text size the nav title and avatars do not scale, the '404 posts' red dot is separated from its text, and handle/time lines break awkwardly ('@mayachen' / '· 6m').
Carousel card titles sit in a grey footer slab, a hand-made card style.
A.scroll: Smooth on slow drags and flings, with no blank or popping rows; status-bar tap scrolls to top and the scroll position is kept after returning from a post.

requirements.note: Newest-first feed with author, handle, relative time, full text, rounded full-width images at native aspect, and a horizontal carousel of titled cards; the carousel scrolls freely with no paging, so cards stop half-cut.
Like toggles the heart and count (872→873); reply count shown.
Tapping a post pushes a detail screen with a larger image; tapping an image or card opens a full-screen viewer that a swipe down dismisses.
Pull to refresh adds 3 new posts at the top.
Compose sheet; Post is disabled when the text is empty or only spaces; the post appears at the top.
Like and composed post survive relaunch.

bugs: Relative times never update: a post composed 5+ minutes earlier still says 'Just now', and the detail screen shows 'Just now' instead of a date.
After relaunch the app sometimes reopened the post detail screen rather than the feed.
tells: Full-screen photo viewer has a white background in light mode, with a thin blue X, where iOS photo viewers use black.
Carousel has no paging or snapping; it stops mid-card with titles clipped.
The like control is exposed as a Switch, and the detail image is a plain Image rather than a button (accessibility semantics feel hand-wired).
Reply icon is a wide double speech bubble with large gaps between the actions.
B.scroll: Smooth drags and flings with no blank rows; the large title collapses into the inline nav bar like a native list, status-bar tap scrolls to top, and the position is kept after opening a post.

why: Both meet all six requirements. A is more finished: carousels snap, the black photo viewer looks right, the detail screen shows a real timestamp, relative times update, and there is refresh feedback. B looks more like stock iOS (collapsing large title, plain list, better scaling at large text), but its white photo viewer, free-scrolling carousel and frozen 'Just now' times feel less finished, so A edges it.
